name: ainecto
description: Shared project memory for people and AI agents: workspaces, documents, ERD, diagrams and boards.

interface.longDescription: AiNecto is shared project memory for people and AI agents. Your agent can see what is waiting for you (notifications, to-dos and assigned kanban cards), find and review documents with comments, run kanban cards through their workflow, set up workspaces and projects, and write status reports — all against the same workspaces, documents, ERDs, diagrams and boards your team uses on ainecto.com. Sign in once with your AiNecto account; what the agent may change is decided by your AiNecto permissions.
